source_title: Calculating Mahadasha in Vedic Astrology & Numerology (Study Notes)

calculation_methodology.step_1_starting_cycle: First Mahadasha starts at Date of Birth. The starting planet is determined by the King (Driver) number.
calculation_methodology.step_1_duration: Duration of the first Mahadasha equals the King (Driver) number in years (e.g. King 4 has 4 years duration).
calculation_methodology.step_2_sequence: Subsequent Mahadashas follow the numerical planetary cycle: 1 (Sun, 1 yr) -> 2 (Moon, 2 yrs) -> 3 (Jupiter, 3 yrs) -> 4 (Rahu, 4 yrs) -> 5 (Mercury, 5 yrs) -> 6 (Venus, 6 yrs) -> 7 (Ketu, 7 yrs) -> 8 (Saturn, 8 yrs) -> 9 (Mars, 9 yrs), wrapping around circularly from 9 to 1.

rating_criteria.criterion_1: Is MD number present in native's Lo Shu Grid? (+1.0 point if present, 0 if missing)
rating_criteria.criterion_2: Compatibility of MD planet with native King (Driver) number: +2.0 for Friendly/Compatible, +1.0 for Neutral, 0.0 for Anti/Enemy

thresholds.average: Score 2.0 - 2.5 (Average results, mixed outcomes, steady effort required)
thresholds.challenging: Score below 2.0 (Hurdles, delays, requires active remedial alignment)

hierarchy_of_timing.personal_year_py: Shorter period; impacts are higher than Mahadasha alone.
hierarchy_of_timing.personal_month_pm: Monthly period; immediate impacts are even higher than PY.
hierarchy_of_timing.synthesis_rule: When both Mahadasha and Personal Year are favorable, they multiply positive results. If both are difficult, extra remedial discipline is necessary.

house_property_acquisition.lo_shu_grid_reinforcement: Presence of 2, 5, 8 (Earth Plane) or 9 (Fire/Mars energy) strongly activates real estate acquisition.

job_promotion_and_growth.remedies: Pay homage to Guru/elders on Thursdays; surround oneself with natural wood.

job_termination_risk_alert.condition: Personal Year is Anti to King Number and compatibility is below 20%.
